zaragoza_efficiency_real_sample.description: Paper-reported efficiency target for Zaragoza-style reconstruction. The paper reports about 0.17 s runtime and less than 50 MB memory for its public Zaragoza evaluation, while prior volumetric methods require more than 6.39 s and more than 13.105 GB memory.

complexity_scaling_cubic_measurements.description: Table 1 memory-scaling claim for cubic N x N x N measurements. The paper reports O(N^3) memory for the traditional implementation and O(N^2) memory for the sequential-loading implementation.
